instruction: Open C:\Users\User\Desktop\p1.step, C:\Users\User\Desktop\p2.step, C:\Users\User\Desktop\p3.step, C:\Users\User\Desktop\tools.csv in SolidCAM. Create independent Profile outside-contour operations for C:\Users\User\Desktop\p1.step, C:\Users\User\Desktop\p2.step, and C:\Users\User\Desktop\p3.step. Each STEP part must use its own top-face center as Coordinate System. Tool definition: T1 is a 6 mm end mill reused for the three profile programs. Write the required output file(s) to the Desktop using exactly these absolute paths: C:\Users\User\Desktop\p1.nc, C:\Users\User\Desktop\p2.nc, C:\Users\User\Desktop\p3.nc. [Software] SolidCAM runs inside SOLIDWORKS; start SOLIDWORKS from `C:\Program Files\SOLIDWORKS Corp\SOLIDWORKS\` first (adjust path).
